subject: Invoice delivery: AP prefers portal but needs VAT evidence + CC dedupe
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery for Nimbus — AP wants portal + VAT certificate

Ben / Laura,

Quick heads-up: Nimbus (AP contact Alex Turner) responded to our onboarding checklist. They said their AP team will only accept invoices via their vendor portal for new suppliers, but they also need a VAT registration certificate on file before they will release payment. Two small wrinkles they called out:

- Their portal dedupes by invoice number and matches line-level tax. If we send same invoice to multiple emails (billing@ and ap@) they sometimes flag duplicates.
- The portal will not accept XML e-invoice payloads from new vendors until we complete a vendor profile (they requested company reg number / tax country).

I attached a sample PDF invoice and a copy of the VAT cert Nimbus uploaded earlier for reference. Can we:
1) Confirm the canonical billing contact we want to register in their portal (Billing contact vs AP contact) — they prefer a single vendor admin email.
2) Confirm whether we should stop sending invoice copies to billing@nimbusanalytics.com once we register the portal, to avoid duplicates.
3) If we need to provide a different invoice number sequence for portal ingestion, recommend approach.

I'll draft the vendor registration details to submit once we agree. Alex asked if we can get this turned around this week to avoid delaying May invoice payment.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: redwood_sample_invoice_202805.pdf (invoice PDF, stub), nimbus_vat_certificate.pdf (VAT cert, stub)

From: Alex Turner <ap@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Nimbus Analytics Billing <billing@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Tue, 14 May 2028 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery for Nimbus — AP wants portal + VAT certificate

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick reply. A couple clarifications from our side: 

1) Use vendor_admin@nimbusanalytics.com as the single vendor admin when you register. That address is where portal notifications (invoice status / rejections) will land.
2) Once the vendor profile is active, please do not send copies to billing@nimbusanalytics.com to avoid duplicates. We will fetch the invoices from the portal for reconciliation.
3) Invoice numbering: keep your existing numbers, but append the vendor profile ID we give you (e.g., RDW-12345) in the invoice metadata field in the portal.

Regarding VAT: we need an official VAT registration document (scanned certificate or tax authority excerpt) for the billing entity. The copy you sent is fine but must show the VAT number and registered country clearly. If you can re-upload as a single PDF during registration that would be best.

Finally, our portal has a file size limit of 5MB for PDF uploads — if your generated invoices are larger, you'll need to reduce the export size or use the portal's SFTP endpoint.

Alex Turner
AP Manager, Nimbus Analytics
ap@nimbusanalytics.com | +1 646-555-0102

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 15 May 2028 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery for Nimbus — AP wants portal + VAT certificate

Thanks for the notes — flagged a couple operational items: 

- Billing contact: we should register billing@redwood.com as the portal contact but set vendor_admin@nimbusanalytics.com as the notification target in the portal settings (so receipts/reporting push back to them). That avoids exposing team inboxes but keeps our billing pipeline consolidated.
- Deduping: we should stop sending invoices to billing@nimbusanalytics.com after successful registration. But we need a short fallback plan in case their portal ingestion fails (e.g., automated retry + email fallback for 7 days).
- Invoice numbering: rather than appending in the visible invoice number, put the Nimbus vendor ID in a custom metadata field in the portal and keep human-facing invoice numbers unchanged.

Action items:
1) Marissa — please confirm the billing entity legal name and VAT number we should upload (I think it should be Redwood Inference, Inc. — VAT: US-EIN or equivalent).
2) Laura — can you confirm PDF generation settings to keep invoices <5MB and include embedded invoice metadata (vendor_id field)?

If we get this turned around today we can register and push May invoice via portal tomorrow.

Ben Carter
Head of Customer FinOps
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 510-555-0146

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <ap@nimbusanalytics.com>, Nimbus Analytics Billing <billing@nimbusanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 May 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery for Nimbus — AP wants portal + VAT certificate

Alex — thanks, confirmed. Finalizing details below and attaching the cleaned VAT cert.

Vendor profile registration data (to submit to vendor_admin@nimbusanalytics.com):
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Billing contact (portal primary): billing@redwood.com
- Notification target: vendor_admin@nimbusanalytics.com
- VAT / Tax identifier: US-EIN: 12-3456789 (PDF provided)
- Preferred invoice format: PDF (single-file), <5MB
- Fallback plan: If portal ingestion returns an error code or we don't get a retrieval confirmation within 24 hours, we'll queue a one-time email delivery to billing@nimbusanalytics.com and notify AP. We will not routinely email copies once portal is validated.

Attached: updated nimbus_vat_certificate.pdf (single combined page, redacted where appropriate). Also attaching the sample invoice PDF we will register as the template (redwood_sample_invoice_202805.pdf).

Please confirm vendor profile ID once created so we can include it in the portal metadata field for future invoices. If you need any different legal entity name (e.g., Redwood Inference UK Ltd) for VAT reasons, loop me in and we'll supply the alternate cert.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Revenue Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: redwood_sample_invoice_202805.pdf (invoice PDF, stub), nimbus_vat_certificate.pdf (VAT cert, stub)
